Legal & Policies

Terms of Service & Privacy Policy

Please review the terms of service and privacy practices for using Nora Studio and its associated services.

Terms of Service

Last Updated: September 26, 2026

Welcome to Nora Studio. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Nora Discord bot, our dashboard at vaztinix.dev, and our associated tools and services.

By adding Nora to your Discord server, logging into the dashboard, or using any Nora commands, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

1. Eligibility

To use Nora, you must:

  • Be at least 13 years old (or the minimum legal age for digital services in your country), in compliance with Discord's Terms of Service.
  • Have the necessary permissions (such as Manage Server or Administrator) if you are adding or configuring Nora in a Discord server.
  • Follow Discord's official Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

2. Acceptable Use

You agree not to misuse Nora or help anyone else do so. Prohibited activities include:

  1. Attempting to attack, overload, spam, or exploit Nora's API, servers, or systems.
  2. Using Nora in servers that distribute malware, facilitate illegal content, engage in harassment, or violate Discord's policies.
  3. Scraping or harvesting member data or user information through Nora for commercial or spam purposes.
  4. Impersonating Nora developers or staff members.
Violations: Servers or users found abusing Nora or violating these terms may be blocked from using Nora without prior notice.

3. Server Management & Responsibilities

Server administrators are responsible for how Nora is configured in their community:

  • Role Hierarchy: Ensure Nora's bot role is placed above the roles it manages in Discord. Nora cannot assign or modify roles positioned above it.
  • AutoMod Settings: Server staff are responsible for configuring moderation filters and reviewing actions taken by automated systems.
  • Channel Security: Ensure sensitive audit logs and ticket channels are restricted to authorized moderators and staff.

4. Roblox Verification & Group Sync

Nora provides Roblox account verification and group rank syncing:

  • No Passwords or Cookies: Nora will never ask for or store your Roblox password or session cookies (.ROBLOSECURITY). Verification uses public codes or official Roblox OAuth2.
  • Public Information: Nora only checks public user details (such as username, user ID, and group rank) to sync corresponding Discord roles.
  • Unlinking: You can disconnect your Roblox account at any time by running /verify unlink in Discord or via the web portal.

5. Subscriptions & Payments

Nora offers optional premium features ("Nora Studio Plus"):

  • Discord App Monetization: Payments, renewals, and cancellations are handled directly by Discord. Nora does not store or process your credit card or financial details.
  • Managing Subscriptions: You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Discord client under User Settings → Subscriptions.
  • Refunds: Billing and refunds are governed by Discord's Refund Policy.

6. Availability & Disclaimers

Nora is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. While we strive to maintain high uptime, service may occasionally be affected by maintenance, updates, or third-party outages (such as Discord API downtime).

7. Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Significant changes will be announced in our Discord server. Continued use of Nora after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions or legal inquiries regarding these Terms of Service, please reach out:

  • Discord Support: Join our Nora Support Server
  • Direct Email: vaztinixstudios@gmail.com or vaztinixbitter@gmail.com

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 26, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what data Nora Studio collects, how it is used, and how you can manage or delete your information.

Privacy First: We do not sell, rent, or trade your data to third parties or advertisers.

1. Data We Collect

We only collect data necessary to provide Nora's features:

Data Type What We Store Why It's Needed How Long It's Kept
Server Settings Discord Server ID, Channel IDs, Role IDs, Feature Toggles To save your server's custom configurations (welcome channels, automod rules, logging channels). Until Nora is removed from the server or data is purged by the server owner.
Roblox Verification Discord User ID mapped to Roblox User ID & Username To automatically give members the correct Discord roles based on their Roblox group rank. Until the user runs /verify unlink or deletes their account data.
Leveling & XP User ID, XP points, Level number, Rank card background choice To calculate server leveling progression, render rank cards, and assign level reward roles. Stored per server; can be wiped anytime via /mycard.
Moderation Logs Case ID, Target User ID, Moderator ID, Reason, Timestamp To provide server moderators with a record of past warnings, mutes, kicks, and bans. Stored per server for mod history; purgeable on request.
Ticket Transcripts Chat messages inside closed support ticket channels Saved so server staff can review closed customer support cases. Encrypted and automatically deleted after 30 days.
Rate Limiting (Security) Temporary anonymized IP hash in memory To protect login endpoints and web forms against malicious bot attacks. Cleared automatically from memory every 15–60 minutes. Never saved to a database.

2. What We NEVER Collect or Store

To avoid any ambiguity, Nora does NOT collect or have access to:

  • Your Discord password or payment credentials (all handled by Discord).
  • Your Roblox password or .ROBLOSECURITY cookies.
  • Your personal real-world name, home address, phone number, or government identity.
  • Your private direct messages (DMs) or server chat messages (outside of configured moderation logging and closed support tickets).

3. Data Security & Storage

All communication between your browser, Discord, and Nora's backend is encrypted with industry-standard TLS 1.3. Our databases are secured with encrypted volume storage, firewalls, and strict access controls to ensure your community data is protected from unauthorized access.

4. How to Delete Your Data (Self-Service)

You have full control over your data. You don't need to file support tickets or wait for an email to delete your records:

  • Individual User Wipe: Run /mycard in Discord, click the red "Erase Data" button, and confirm. Nora will instantly wipe your leveling XP, rank settings, and linked profiles.
  • Server Owner Wipe: Server owners can run /settings data-delete inside their server to immediately erase all server configs, leveling boards, and mod logs.
  • Roblox Unlink: Run /verify unlink in Discord or visit the Verification Portal to disconnect your Roblox account instantly.

5. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)

Nora is not directed at children under the age of 13. In accordance with COPPA and Discord's Terms of Service, users under 13 are prohibited from creating Discord accounts or using Nora. If we discover that data belongs to an underage user, that data is permanently purged immediately.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions, privacy concerns, or data requests, feel free to reach out directly:

  • Official Discord Server: Join our Nora Support Discord and open a private support ticket.
  • Direct Developer Contact: vaztinixstudios@gmail.com or vaztinixbitter@gmail.com
